title: Endomorphisms in ]X/G[ are the stabilizer
body_html:
Endomorphisms in $\,]X/G[\,$ are the stabilizer

For a cell $E \in X$, the endomorphism monoid of $E$ in the orbit category $]X/G[$ (see The orbit categories ]X/G[ and [X/G]) is canonically the stabilizer $\Fix_G(E) = \{g \in G : g\cdot E = E\}$.

Lemma. The map $g \mapsto g$ induces a bijection $$\Hom_{]X/G[}(E, E) \;\xrightarrow{\sim}\; \Fix_G(E).$$ Moreover this bijection is a monoid isomorphism when the endomorphism monoid uses the standard convention $\alpha \cdot \beta := \beta \circ \alpha$ (function-composition order).
proof_html:
By definition $\Hom_{]X/G[}(E, E) = \{g \in G : g\cdot E \preceq E\}$. For a cellular action, $\dim(g\cdot E) = \dim E$ (Cellular G-action on an abstract cell complex). Since the abstract cell complex separates proper faces by strict dimension (Abstract cell complex), $g\cdot E \preceq E$ together with equal dimensions forces $g\cdot E = E$, i.e. $g \in \Fix_G(E)$. Conversely $g \in \Fix_G(E)$ trivially gives $g \cdot E = E \preceq E$. The two constructions are inverse. $\square$

Multiplicativity in the endomorphism-monoid direction: composition $\alpha \circ \beta$ in $]X/G[$ has group element $\alpha \cdot \beta$ (Lean's ≫ on Mor gives the group product with the right factor first). The mathlib CategoryTheory.End monoid uses x * y := y ≫ x, so $\mathrm{End}(E)\cdot \Fix_G(E)$ multiplication conventions align on the nose and the map is a MonoidHom / MulEquiv.

Lean formalization

OrbitCat.endMorEquivStabilizer E : Mor E E ≃ MulAction.stabilizer G E is the underlying Equiv. The monoid isomorphism OrbitCat.endMulEquivStabilizer E : End E ≃* MulAction.stabilizer G E adds map_mul' (proved by rfl — the convention alignment is definitional). Its forward direction is packaged as OrbitCat.endToStabilizer : End E →* MulAction.stabilizer G E for downstream composition with monoid homs.

The AbstractCellComplex.dim_lt axiom (a proper face has strictly smaller dimension) together with GCellComplex.smul_dim (the G-action preserves dimension) close the surjectivity direction by omega.

deps.title: Cellular G-action on an abstract cell complex

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.endMorEquivStabilizer
lean_refs.signature:
def endMorEquivStabilizer (E : OrbitCat G X) :
    Mor E E ≃ MulAction.stabilizer G (E : X) where
  toFun α := ⟨α.val, by
    show α.val • (E : X) = E
    by_contra h_ne
    have h_lt : AbstractCellComplex.dim (α.val • (E : X)) <
        AbstractCellComplex.dim (E : X) :=
      AbstractCellComplex.dim_lt α.property h_ne
    have h_eq : AbstractCellComplex.dim (α.val • (E : X)) =
        AbstractCellComplex.dim (E : X) :=
      GCellComplex.smul_dim α.val E
    omega⟩
  invFun k := ⟨k.val, by
    show k.val • (E : X) ≤ (E : X)
    rw [(k.property : k.val • (E : X) = E)]⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.OrbitCat.endMulEquivStabilizer
lean_refs.signature:
def endMulEquivStabilizer (E : OrbitCat G X) :
    End E ≃* MulAction.stabilizer G (E : X) where
  toEquiv := endMorEquivStabilizer E
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
